```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(benchmarkme)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
```

```{r loadData}
convert_bytes_to_mib <- function(bytes) {
  mib <- bytes / (2^20)
  return(mib)
}

sizeTable <- read.table("dataOutput/4_variables_benchmark/qfeatures_size_report.tsv", header = TRUE)

sizeCols <- grep("size", colnames(sizeTable))
for (sizeCol in sizeCols) {
    sizeTable[[paste0(colnames(sizeTable)[[sizeCol]], "_MiB")]] <- convert_bytes_to_mib(sizeTable[[sizeCol]])
}
sizeTable$totalCells <- sizeTable$nCell * sizeTable$nAssay
DT::datatable(sizeTable)
```

```{r compareLFTMT}
# For the same number of cells: 

# - nCell = 1, nAssay = 256, nFeat = 4000, nCol = 200      => * 4
# - nCell = 16, nAssay = 32, nFeat = 4000, nCol = 200      => * 2
# - nCell = 32, nAssay = 32, nFeat = 4000, nCol = 200

sizeLFTMT <- sizeTable %>% 
    filter(nFeat == 4000,
           nCol == 200,
           (nAssay == 32 | nAssay == 256)) %>% 
    filter(!(nCell == 16 & nAssay == 256),
           !(nCell == 32 & nAssay == 256),
           !(nCell == 1 & nAssay == 32)) %>% 
    mutate(totalCells = as.factor(totalCells),
           nCell = as.factor(nCell))

sizeLFTMT[1, "sizeTotal_MiB"]  <- sizeLFTMT[1, "sizeTotal_MiB"] * 4
sizeLFTMT[2, "sizeTotal_MiB"]  <- sizeLFTMT[2, "sizeTotal_MiB"] * 2


ggplot(sizeLFTMT, aes(x = nCell, y = sizeTotal_MiB))+
           geom_col()
```

```{r rowDataRatio}

plotRowDataRatio <- sizeTable %>% 
    filter(nFeat == 4000) %>% 
    mutate(nCell = as.factor(nCell),
           nAssay = as.factor(nAssay),
           nCol = as.factor(nCol),
           ratioRowData = sizeRowData / sizeTotal) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = nCell, y = nAssay, fill = ratioRowData)) +
        geom_tile() +
        facet_wrap(~nCol)
ggplotly(plotRowDataRatio)
```

```{r nFeat}

# total QFeatures size
sizeTable %>% 
    filter(nAssay == 256,
           nCol == 200) %>% 
    mutate(nCell = as.factor(nCell),
           nFeat = as.factor(nFeat)) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = nFeat, y = sizeTotal_MiB))+
        geom_col()+
        facet_wrap(~nCell)

# assay size

sizeTable %>% 
    filter(nAssay == 256,
           nCol == 200) %>% 
    mutate(nCell = as.factor(nCell),
           nFeat = as.factor(nFeat)) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = nFeat, y = sizeAssay_MiB))+
        geom_col()+
        facet_wrap(~nCell)

# rowData size

sizeTable %>% 
    filter(nAssay == 256,
           nCol == 200) %>% 
    mutate(nCell = as.factor(nCell),
           nFeat = as.factor(nFeat)) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = nFeat, y = sizeRowData_MiB))+
        geom_col()+
        facet_wrap(~nCell)
```

```{r propComponent}
propTable <- sizeTable %>% 
    filter(nCol == 50) %>% 
    colSums() %>% 
    as.data.frame()

propTable$component <- rownames(propTable)
propTable <- propTable[rownames(propTable) %in% c("sizeTotal", "sizeRowData", "sizeColData", "sizeAssay"),]
colnames(propTable)[1] <- "size"

ggplot(propTable[-1,], aes(x="", y=size, fill=component)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", width=1, color="white") +
  coord_polar("y", start=0) +
  theme_void()

fig <- plot_ly(propTable[-1,], labels = ~component, values = ~size, type = 'pie')

fig <- fig %>% layout(title = 'ratio of the different components of a QFeatures',

         xaxis = list(showgrid = FALSE, zeroline = FALSE, showticklabels = FALSE),

         yaxis = list(showgrid = FALSE, zeroline = FALSE, showticklabels = FALSE))
fig
```
